hebrewText: וְ/אֵ֨ת אוּלָ֤ם הָֽ/עַמּוּדִים֙ עָשָׂ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רָחְבּ֑/וֹ וְ/אוּלָם֙ עַל פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/עַמֻּדִ֥ים וְ/עָ֖ב עַל פְּנֵי/הֶֽם

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
a vestibule (as bound to the building)
a column (as standing); also a stand, i.e. platform
to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
